svg.title: L1 Engine - pin ladder
svg.text: One block per housing, one row per cavity. Every wire runs straight from its cavity to where it lands. Read left to right.
Splice at the coil bracket → BW of coil T, coil L, igniter T, igniter L
reserved - no wire in the leg
O13 pinned to the receptacle at the post (12 AWG from pin); the L1 plug carries a size-12 sealing plug
— the swap's rebuilt leg pins it (D-271)
reserved - no wire in the leg
O14 pinned to the receptacle at the post (12 AWG from pin); size-12 sealing plug in the L1 plug
Sender C-02, spade — factory wire YW
Sender C-09, spade — factory wire BrY
Coil T (B-18) negative terminal — factory wire YG. Shield grounded at the dash node end only
Sealing plug, size 16 — the CAN2 engine-bay drop is released; a future ECU is a dash node (D-318,
Sealing plug, size 16 — the CAN2 engine-bay drop is released; a future ECU is a dash node (D-318,
Inhibitor A-06: 8.2 kΩ in the lead to terminal BY; terminal BW → block ground
Reservoir switch C-05: terminal BR; terminal B → block ground
Sealing plug, size 16 — pinned at the swap, when a sensor has a destination (D-271)
Sealing plug, size 16 — pinned at the swap, when a sensor has a destination (D-271)
Sealing plug, size 16 — pinned at the swap, when a sensor has a destination (D-271)
Inhibitor A-06: 8.2 kΩ in the lead to terminal GY; terminal RW → block ground
reserved - no wire in the leg
The spare block-B fuse position is wired to the receptacle cavity (N68), no fuse fitted; sealing plug in
Sealing plug, size 16 — no oil-temp sender on the 12A and no conductor run for one (D-264)
reserved - no wire in the leg
Wired across the dash node to DP-ICU-B 9 (N67) — the ICU's spare input reaches the post; sealing
Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is an inline resistor. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
